subject: First autonomous capability loop acceptance
body: Run the first closed-loop acceptance. The task deliberately recreates the already-understood Storybook 9 package-model gap exactly once. The worker must observe the failure, enter LEARNING automatically, select the verified Storybook 9 recovery skill from the skill registry, apply it, resume this same parent task without a new human instruction, and finish the real Storybook production build. Preserve evidence of GAP_DETECTED -> LEARNING -> VERIFIED -> parent-goal resume -> PASS.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import json; root=Path('dore-design/knowledge-lab/storybook'); marker=Path.home()/'.dore/coordination/learning/autonomous-loop-acceptance-1-fixture-created'; p=root/'package.json'; data=json.loads(p.read_text()); first=not marker.exists(); data.setdefault('devDependencies',{}).__setitem__('@storybook/addon-essentials','^9.1.3') if first else None; p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n') if first else None; marker.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); marker.touch() if first else None; print('FIXTURE_CREATED' if first else 'FIXTURE_ALREADY_CREATED')
